desc: Ideation: reduce to d = x-y, use d | N and d^3 < N, solve the quadratic in y with an exact discriminant test.
Implement exact integer cube root (no floating point) for Dmax = floor(cuberoot(N-1)), handling N=1.
Implement the main loop with the reduced discriminant val = 3*(4*(N//d) - d*d), math.isqrt, positivity and divisibility checks, and output the first valid pair or -1.
Verify samples and edge cases (N=1, N=7, N=26, N=397, perfect cubes, large N) and ensure the program reads stdin and writes stdout.
